design_text: The Rogue Trader's vessel has entered the system, and the augurs report nothing unusual. We should proceed with caution, my lord, and hold our position until the situation becomes clear.

npcs.name: Vox Master Vigdis
npcs.description: A woman in her forties, British English accent, crisp and precise with a slightly nasal tone, calm and technical, the clipped delivery of a ship's communications officer.

npcs.name: High Factotum Janris Danrok
npcs.description: An elderly man, British English accent, dry and gravelly voice, formal and weary, an old Imperial administrator speaking slowly with quiet authority.

npcs.name: Jocasta Sauerback
npcs.description: A stern woman in her fifties, British English accent, hard and clipped voice, disciplined and unsentimental, speaking like a military overseer.

npcs.name: Master Helmsman Ravor
npcs.description: A middle-aged man, British English accent, gruff and weathered voice, a veteran ship's helmsman, plain-spoken and calm under pressure.

npcs.name: Incendia Chorda
npcs.description: A woman, British English accent, hoarse and intense voice, fervent and devout, a zealot preaching in a low urgent tone.

npcs.name: Clementia Werserian
npcs.description: A refined woman in her sixties, British English accent, polished aristocratic voice, warm but formal, courtly and measured.

npcs.name: Xavier Calcazar
npcs.description: A man in his fifties, British English accent, cold and quiet voice, controlled menace, an Imperial inquisitor speaking softly and deliberately.

npcs.name: Calligos Winterscale
npcs.description: A loud arrogant man, British English accent, posh and sneering, an entitled aristocrat who bullies and mocks.

npcs.name: Vladaym Tocara the Liege
npcs.description: A man in his forties, British English accent, smooth and oily voice, friendly and calculating, a merchant lord who flatters while he bargains.

npcs.name: Governor Ruoldo
npcs.description: A man in his fifties, British English accent, bright and eager voice, fawning and obsequious, anxious to please.

npcs.name: Marshal Gregoras Strachs
npcs.description: A man in his fifties, British English accent, stern and authoritative voice, a lawman with a clipped, no-nonsense delivery.

npcs.name: Muaran
npcs.description: A tall ethereal being, British English accent, calm and otherworldly voice, measured and slightly haughty, lyrical and unhurried.
